description: Application for non-material amendment to planning permission reference 163250FUL dated 12.10.2016 'Conversion of existing dwelling into six no. self-contained flats (3x3 bedroom, 2x2 bedroom, 1x1 bedroom) single storey rear extension, rear roof extension with installation of two rooflights to front roofslope (following demolition of two storey side extension, rear extension and external staircase); construction of two no. 3-bedroom, three-storey, semi-detached houses with basements and associated lightwells; provision of amenity space, bicycle and vehicle parking, refuse storage and tree planting'. Amendments seeks to reduce the private rear gardens of Flat 2, on Block A, from 45m2 to 36m2 and the 3 bedroom houses, on Block B, from 50m2 to 35m2.
